description: In a regular cardinal order of uncountable cofinality, every stationary set has the full cardinality of the ambient order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.stationary_cardinality.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  [IsRegularCardinalOrder α] (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) {S : Set α} (hS : IsStationary S) :
  Cardinal.mk ↑S = Cardinal.mk α
